# Agenda 

- demo: docusaurus vs. gatsby
- divorcing structure from data: the role of JSON schema in testing spec compliance. rpc-compat tests should just validate against a schema. dependency on underlying data should be minimized or eliminated.

## Styleguide

- guidelines on error handling; get the code right, get the message helpful and accurate
- Empty search results: 200/null , 200/[], or -3200: Not Found?
- Ordering of error reporting - specifying error reporting often [impacts logic flow](https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/issues/8640) from clients.

## PRs
- [Adding timestamps to log receipts](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/639/files)
- Error Codes - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/658
